title: Tiny, cute lantern
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff7b0'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ffd54a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff9d2e'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M38 22 Q50 6 62 22' fill='none' stroke='#c98a3c' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- top cap -->
  <rect x='34' y='22' width='32' height='7' rx='3' fill='#e0a648'/>
  <rect x='34' y='27' width='32' height='2' rx='1' fill='#b8742a'/>
  <!-- body glass -->
  <rect x='33' y='30' width='34' height='40' rx='6' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- inner flame -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='8' ry='12' fill='#ffec8a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='4' ry='7' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <!-- glass frame posts -->
  <rect x='33' y='30' width='3' height='40' rx='1.5' fill='#e0a648'/>
  <rect x='64' y='30' width='3' height='40' rx='1.5' fill='#e0a648'/>
  <rect x='44.5' y='30' width='2' height='40' fill='#f2c169' opacity='0.5'/>
  <rect x='53.5' y='30' width='2' height='40' fill='#f2c169' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- bottom cap -->
  <rect x='34' y='68' width='32' height='7' rx='3' fill='#e0a648'/>
  <rect x='37' y='74' width='26' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#b8742a'/>
  <!-- little glowing cheeks -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='48' r='2' fill='#fff3c0' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='48' r='2' fill='#fff3c0' opacity='0.9'/>
</svg>
